label: ✅ Data quality expectations
description: Assert data quality rules (column.unique, column.in [...], column.between, row_count.between, etc). Each violation surfaces in the run's artifacts panel; failures can optionally fail the run.

rules.label: Rules
rules.help: List of objects: {kind, column?, args} where kind ∈ unique | not_null | between | in | regex_match | row_count_between.

fail_on_violation.label: Fail run on any violation
fail_on_violation.help: If true, the step raises an error and the run is marked failed when any rule reports a violation.
